The Quiet Captain of Gull Point

By a staff writer

Marlow Vance does not like interviews, and he says so. Colleagues describe him as dry, patient and allergic to fuss. "He will fix a winch with a shoelace before he signs a purchase order," said one deckhand.

Vance's catchphrase around the harbor is almost a town motto. "We fix the boat we have," he told the council in 2019, when they proposed a replacement vessel.

Former crew say the captain's humor is bone dry and mostly aimed at himself. "I am the oldest working part on that ferry," he joked at the anniversary dinner, "and nobody has replaced me either."

He has a famously tense relationship with the regional transport board, which he calls "the people with the nice pens." He is close to his first mate, Dana Reyes, whom he describes as the only person allowed to argue with him on deck.
